messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#35421 - nebula-retail-dedicated - p99 latency > 1.2s for 5m, error-rate spike 4.3%
pagerduty-bot: Incident created -> https://pd.example/35421 (sev: high). Paging eng-oncall rota.
maya: acked. I'm on it. Pulling metrics now. :eyes:
aj: also here, will grab logs and contact Nebula if needed.
sam: seeing queue growth on reserved-pool-NEB-01, backlog depth ~420 requests, cpu ok, io wait high on worker-3.
nebula-retail-sre: we're seeing degraded response for product search calls in our app, customers report timeouts ~5-7s. Any ETA?
maya: digging. Initial hypothesis: KV cache fallback thrashing + burst-queue saturation after a KV eviction storm.
sre-lead: if we confirm kvcache thrash, follow runbook -> reduce batch_window, enable burst_bypass, and scale reserved pool by +2 nodes. Notify me before scaling.
aj: log snippet from worker-3:
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] WARN kv_cache: miss_rate=0.67 evictions=812
[2026-03-14T09:12:04Z] ERROR dispatch: queue_len=430 dispatch_latency_ms=1250
```
maya: running quick mitigation: toggling config to smaller batching and enabling burst_bypass.
Command:
```
redwoodctl cluster update nebula-reserved --set batch_window_ms=25 --set burst_bypass=true
```
aj: doing a soft restart of worker-3 now (rolling): `kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker-3 -n nebula-reserved`
pagerduty-bot: maya acknowledged PD#35421 at 09:15 UTC.
nebula-retail-sre: thanks, we can confirm some requests are getting through faster already. Monitoring from our side.
sam: after toggles, p99 dropped from 1.3s -> 0.85s in last 90s, error-rate down to 1.1%. queue depth 120 and falling.
maya: good. I'm going to open a short incident note and mark immediate mitigation applied. Will keep cluster scaled at +2 nodes for 30m to stabilize.
sre-lead: prepare RCA checklist: record trigger, config changes, exact nodes added, and any manual restarts. Also include Nebula impact window for CS.
aj: Nebula asked for an ETA for full recovery. I'll tell them provisional ETA 20-30m, will update.
nebula-retail-sre: appreciated. Also please flag whether this will recur - we have a traffic spike later today at 11:00 UTC.
maya: capturing that — schedule a follow-up before the spike to validate kvcache warming and consider pre-warming or short-term increased reserved capacity.
sam: putting a watch on all nebula-reserved workers and enabling detailed logs for 1h.
incident-bot: Note saved to incident PD#35421: mitigation applied (batch_window=25ms, burst_bypass=true, +2 nodes).
aj: handing off to night oncall in 35m — @sam will continue monitoring and liaise with Nebula. If metrics regress, escalate to sre-lead and reopen PD.
sam: on it. I'll post a short status update to #customer-success and ping Nebula with the mitigation summary and expected follow-up.
nebula-retail-sre: thanks all. We'll watch our side and let you know if we see anomalies during the 11:00 spike.
maya: final note: root cause suspected kvcache eviction cascade after a small config change (recent model rollout caused larger prefix variety). Action items: 1) RCA draft, 2) plan pre-warm for Nebula's 11:00 spike, 3) add automated pre-warm trigger for high-variety rollouts.
sre-lead: agreed. Good work. Closing immediate pager. Leave channel open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
